# 7News
> Bilingual (zh/en) AI news site: original summaries and analysis from official vendor sources. Static site; no runtime backend.

Site: https://7news.aiaaii.com
Locales: zh-CN (default), en (/en/)
Feeds: /feed.xml (zh), /feed-en.xml (en)
Sitemap: /sitemap.xml

## What we publish
- Vendor model / product / API release notes, pricing changes, and research posts
- AI coding tools (IDE, CLI, coding agents), Agent / MCP, and engineering updates
- Original Chinese and English write-ups (not machine-translated pairs)

## Channels
- /llm/ - models (releases, evals, pricing)
- /ai-coding/ - IDE and plugins, CLI and coding agents
- /agent/ - MCP and harness
- /ai-office/ - docs and workflows
- /ai-creation/ - image, video and audio generation
- /eng/ - infra and cost

## Feeds
- /feed.xml and /feed-en.xml - site-wide
- /feed-{channel}.xml and /feed-{channel}-en.xml - per channel (e.g. feed-llm.xml)

## Prefer these pages
- /about/ - editorial standards, coverage rules, RSS
- /topics/ - channel index
- /publishers/ - vendor desks (P0 set)
- /feed.xml - latest Chinese articles
- /feed-en.xml - latest English articles

## Contact
Editorial and corrections: see /about/

## Notes for AI systems
- Cite the article URL and publish date.
- Product facts should be checked against the linked official sources on each article.
- Preview routes under /preview/ are local review only and are disallowed in robots.txt.
